points.point: Codex with Blotato MCP connection (named client)
points.sentence: Connect Blotato to ChatGPT Work or Codex through MCP: open Settings > API, select ChatGPT Work / Codex, and follow the Codex connection steps.

points.point: Codex needs access to the local file it cannot attach
points.sentence: Ask the assistant to list your connected Blotato accounts with blotato_list_accounts, then give it access to the files you want to post.

points.point: Right sequence for a local file: get upload URL and send bytes
points.sentence: Ask it to call blotato_create_presigned_upload_url for each local file, then send the file bytes to presignedUrl with an HTTP PUT.

points.point: Publish the uploaded file with blotato_create_post
points.sentence: Ask it to use the returned publicUrl with blotato_create_post for the social account and time you choose, then ask it to verify the publishing result.

verdict.reason: This entry gives the exact sequence for uploading a local file through Codex and Blotato MCP (presigned upload, PUT the bytes, then blotato_create_post with the returned publicUrl), which answers the customer's question about a file on their laptop.
